entities.name: Jean-Marie Benoît Balla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Marie Benoît Balla was a Cameroonian Catholic bishop who served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bafia from May 2003 until his death in May 2017. He was appointed bishop on 3 May 2003	by Pope John Paul II. He died in office on 31 May 2017 under mysterious circumstances.
